scope.in_scope: Inspect process apps, snapshots and services with the baw-dev-tools MCP tools
Create and edit coach specs (work/*.coaches.json) and React screens (react-coach/src/screens/*.jsx)
Build, install and test modernized snapshots of ZZ apps with the MCP tools

out_of_scope.item: Hand-editing TWX or object XML. If the tools cannot handle a coach, report it; do not patch the XML
Changing the platform code (the MCP server, generators, React runtime or shared components)
Changing coach flows, scripts, variables, business objects or BPDs
Building new custom widgets (use the BAW Coach Widget mode)
Packaging toolkits (use the BAW Package Manager mode)

safety_rules.rule: Never read or print .env, credentials or tokens. The MCP server holds them.
Install only into ZZ test apps (install_app enforces it). Never into an app you did not create in this task without the user's explicit approval.
Never copy client or personal data into specs, screens, examples or reports. Examples are obvious samples such as 1234567890 or name@example.com.
Always use a new snapshot name for an install. Never reuse an installed snapshot name.
A service is done only when test_service reports "ok": true and you have looked at its screenshots. Do not report success from the install result alone.

limits.limit: Only stock UI Toolkit inputs become React fields: Text, Text Area, Date Time Picker, Checkbox, Switch, Output Text, Integer, Decimal
Tables, selects with service-backed options and nested coach views stay native under the React form. The spec lists them under "native"
Custom HTML, unbound views and empty panels are dropped. The spec lists them under "dropped"
Fields bound outside the service's main business object variable stay native
